zh:
牛津大学（University of Oxford）成立于1167年，位于英国牛津市，是英语世界中最古老的大学，也是世界现存第二古老的持续办学高等教育机构。学校采用书院联邦制，由38个独立书院及4个学术学院组成，各书院拥有独立的行政与教学体系。
牛津大学在数学、物理、医学、法学、商学等多个领域拥有崇高的学术地位，有记录的教学活动可追溯至1096年，目前在校生超22000人，其中研究生约12000名。学校的学术传统可追溯至中世纪，培养了72位诺贝尔奖得主、28位英国首相、6位图灵奖得主，在人文社科、自然科学等领域均有深厚的学术积淀。2026QS世界大学排名中，牛津大学位列世界第4位。
en: The University of Oxford is a public research university in Oxford, England. It is the oldest university in the English-speaking world and the world's second-oldest surviving university institution. Founded in 1167, Oxford operates under a collegiate system comprising 38 independent colleges and 4 academic divisions. Oxford holds a dominant global position in mathematics, physics, medicine, law, and business, with teaching documented as early as 1096. Oxford currently has over 22,000 students, including approximately 12,000 graduate students, and has produced 72 Nobel Prize winners, 28 UK prime ministers, and 6 Turing Award winners. Ranked No.4 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
